share_app_text:
Welcome to Vitaway Plus!

Vitaway is your comprehensive health tracking and online consultation platform. Monitor your vital health metrics such as blood pressure, weight, blood glucose, and more with ease. Book online consultations with experienced health coaches, nurses, and doctors for personalized guidance and support. Communicate securely through video calls, audio calls, and messages. Upload your medical records for a thorough review by our healthcare professionals prior to your appointment. Take control of your health journey with Vitaway today.

🔑 Key Features:
- Health tracker
- Health metrics
- Blood pressure monitor
- Weight tracker
- Blood glucose tracker
- Online consultation
- Health coach
- Nurse consultation
- Doctor consultation
- Video call consultation
- Audio call consultation
- Medical records upload
- Wellness app
- Health management

Discover more and get started with Vitaway Plus here: https://bit.ly/4c99Nwk

#VitawayPlus #HealthTracker #WellnessApp #OnlineConsultation #HealthManagement
intro_text: Get help with managing your diabetes, hypertension, and other medical conditions, it’s quick and easy!
nutrition_text: Personalized nutrition and healthy eating at your fingertips. More than a calorie counter, Vitaway helps you adopt nutritious diets that fit your lifestyle and taste. Achieve your weight loss goals while building healthy eating habits for life.
care_text: Vitaway Health connects you with complete care, at your convenience and at an affordable cost. You’ll find what you need to get well—like 24/7 care—alongside primary care, therapy and programs proven to keep you well. With our app, top-quality doctors and data-driven programs are just a tap away.
seamless_care_title: SEAMLESS CARE FOR ALL OF YOU
seamless_care_text: Our app brings together doctors, therapists, dietitians, nurses, coaches and self-guided programs that tend to every aspect of your well-being. If you need in-person care, we can refer you to in-network providers and care sites. But don’t underestimate us.
personal_care_text: Vitaway Health providers and coaches will get to know you. Our video and phone visits have no time limit. Instead of 15 minutes, you might spend an hour talking about your health and planning next steps together.
subscription_text: Vitaway Health is free to download and use with limited features. For the full Vitaway experience, we offer 1-month, 3-month, and annual Premium auto-renewing subscriptions.
secure_confidential_text: We take your privacy seriously. Your health information is secure, private and compliant with a data controller certificate issued by the Rwanda Cyber Security Agency.
stay_on_top_text: Stay on top of your health, monitor your carbs, manage your medicine intake with the Vitaway app, and be in control of your personalized care every day!
